headline: Oil Prices Rise Following Report of US Strike on Iran's Qeshm Island
summary: Oil prices increased following reports of a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island, despite earlier signals from the US and Iran that diplomatic talks were continuing.
why: Crude oil prices are highly sensitive to geopolitical tensions and potential supply disruptions in the Middle East, particularly involving major producers and strategic waterways.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical conflict in the Middle East directly threatens oil supply routes, driving up crude prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reports of military strikes in the Middle East raise concerns over potential disruptions to regional crude oil supplies, immediately lifting futures prices.
